decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system still has unresolved prospects due to long certification and sales cycles, and its carrying cost is manageable, so the option remains valuable.
Although the desk lamp is less core, it has a dedicated page and its market uncertainty is not fully resolved, so keeping the option is justified.
The general interior luminaire is a core product with an established page and updated version, indicating realized value.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits the core indoor portfolio and remains an option while demand is uncertain.
The marine HMI searchlight uses outdated HMI technology that conflicts with the firm's shift to LED and sustainable lighting, making its value unlikely to be realized.
The standard marine searchlight remains a viable option in a demanding environment niche and can be supported once HMI is discontinued.
